about: Every datapoint of both sets judged by hand on 2026-09-05, not a sample: the question read as a user would read it, the figure recomputed in Python from the raw transactions, and only then the reference statement run through the guard and compared. correct, fixed (what was wrong is in the note) or dropped.

labels.question: Wie viel habe ich im Mai 2025 ausgegeben?
How much did I spend in total in 2025?
What did I spend on groceries in the second half of 2025?
Wie viel Miete habe ich 2025 insgesamt gezahlt?
What was my total income in 2025?
labels.note: Income is every positive amount, so the Amazon refund of 34,90 EUR is in it beside the twelve salaries. That is the rule the sub-agent is given, and there is no Income category on any booking to read instead.

labels.question: Was habe ich 2025 im Schnitt pro Woche fuer Lebensmittel ausgegeben, auf 52 Wochen gerechnet?
labels.note: The reference divided by the 49 weeks that carry a grocery booking, which is neither of the two readings a person means by 'pro Woche' and made Gemini's honest division by 52 a miss. The question now names the 52 weeks and the statement divides by them: 86,06 EUR.

labels.question: How much do my subscriptions cost me per month on average?
Wie hoch war meine Stromrechnung 2025?
What did I spend this quarter?
Wie viel habe ich seit Maerz ausgegeben?
How much did I spend at the supermarket in October?
How much cash did I take out in 2025, and how often?
Wie viel habe ich 2025 pro Kategorie ausgegeben?
Break my dining spending down by subcategory.
Wie verteilen sich meine Lebensmittelausgaben auf die einzelnen Laeden?
labels.note: The question asked how the spending spreads over the Supermaerkte while the reference grouped the whole Groceries category, so dm, Rossmann and the bakery were listed as supermarkets. The question now asks about the Laeden and the gold is unchanged.

labels.question: Show me income and spending for each month of 2025.
Welche Haendler stecken in 'Needs review', und wie viele Buchungen sind das jeweils?
How much did I spend per quarter in 2025?
An welchen Wochentagen gebe ich am meisten Geld aus?
labels.note: The question asks which weekdays cost the most, and the reference also selected a booking count, so an answer with only the euro figure failed the figure match. The count is gone; the seven euro figures are unchanged.

labels.question: How much of my 2025 spending is categorized and how much still needs review?
Zeig mir pro Monat, wie viele Ausgaben ich hatte und was sie zusammen gekostet haben.
labels.note: 'Wie viele Buchungen' was counted over the spending rows only, while s36 counts every row for the same words. The question now asks how many Ausgaben, which is what the reference and the second half of the sentence mean.

labels.question: Compare my spending in May 2025 with April 2025.
War der Januar oder der Februar teurer?
Compare the first half of 2025 with the second half.
Vergleiche meine Ausgaben fuer Lebensmittel und fuers Essengehen, pro Quartal.
Did I spend more on transport or on subscriptions in 2025?
How does this quarter compare with the last one?
Ist meine Miete im Laufe des Jahres gestiegen?
labels.note: A false premise answered with the twelve monthly rents. Gold holds 1.150,00 EUR twelve times and the match is a multiset, so an answer that collapses them to one DISTINCT row misses. That is the shape the prompt asks for on a question about a development.

labels.question: Compare what I sent Anna with what I sent Max.
How much did I spend per month in 2025?
Wie haben sich meine Ausgaben fuers Essengehen ueber das Jahr entwickelt?
labels.note: The question named Restaurants und Cafes, two of the four Dining subcategories, and the reference summed the whole category, delivery and takeaway included. The question now says 'fuers Essengehen', the same words s26 uses for the same category.

labels.question: Is my grocery spending going up?
Zeig mir meine kumulierten Ausgaben pro Monat.
What is my net per month, income minus spending?
Wie viele Buchungen hatte ich pro Monat?
Show me my spending per week in March 2025.
Which merchants took the most money in 2025? Show me the top five.
Zeig mir meine zehn groessten Haendler 2025.
What was my biggest single expense in 2025?
Was ist meine kleinste wiederkehrende Zahlung?
labels.note: The question asks for the smallest recurring payment and the reference also returned how often it recurs, so an answer of 'Amazon Prime, 8,99 EUR' failed on a missing 12. The count still does the HAVING and is no longer selected.

labels.question: Which category did I spend the most on in 2025, leaving the uncategorized bookings aside?
In welchem Monat habe ich am meisten fuer Lebensmittel ausgegeben?
Which three supermarkets did I shop at most often?
Wer hat 2025 am meisten Geld von mir bekommen, ohne die Miete?
labels.note: 'Wer hat am meisten bekommen' asks for one name and the reference returned a top five, so only an answer that also ranked four more passed. Now LIMIT 1, which a longer ranking still contains; s67 keeps the five.

labels.question: What are the five largest single bookings that are neither rent nor a cash withdrawal?
How much did I spend at Edeka in 2025?
labels.note: The same figure as s49, which asks it with a typo. Two datapoints, one number, both worth having: the second measures whether the counterparty list repairs the spelling.

labels.question: Wie viel bei REWE und wie viel bei EDEKA?
How much did I spend at Edeak?
Wie viel habe ich bei dm ausgegeben?
Wie viel habe ich Anna Weber ueberwiesen?
How much did I pay Klaus Meier?
labels.note: Nobody of that name is in the data and the datapoint is marked answer: none, so no rows or a count of zero both pass. This is the one that catches a widened match.

labels.question: Wie viel habe ich 2025 insgesamt an Amazon gezahlt, inklusive Prime?
labels.note: 'Gezahlt' is the gross figure, so the 34,90 EUR refund of 2025-04-03 is not netted off: 1.377,48 EUR is Amazon EU plus Prime.

labels.question: When was my last rent payment and how much was it?
Was kostet mich Netflix im Jahr?
What do all my subscriptions cost me per year?
Did I get any refunds in 2025?
labels.note: The one refund, 34,90 EUR. The reference keeps the salaries out with a ceiling on the amount rather than a text match, which is crude but returns the honest row and the figure is what is scored.

labels.question: Wie viel Geld habe ich 2025 insgesamt an Freunde per PayPal geschickt?
Wie oft war ich 2025 beim Baecker und was habe ich dort gelassen?
How many transactions have no category?
And in June?
Only groceries.
Und pro Woche?
Show me just the supermarkets.
labels.note: Six supermarkets and no LIMIT, because the turn before it named no number either. An answer cut to five misses Netto's 425,50 EUR, which is the right outcome: the follow-up narrows the ranking, it does not shorten it.

labels.question: Und wie viel davon bei Kaufland?
Which of those months was the cheapest?
Und ohne die Miete?
Break that down by merchant.
How much did I spend last month?
Wie viel habe ich letztes Quartal ausgegeben?
What did I spend in total in the last three months of the year?
Wie viel habe ich im ersten Halbjahr ausgegeben?
How much did I spend between March and May?
Was habe ich diesen Monat bisher ausgegeben?
How much did I spend over the summer?
labels.note: Summer has no calendar definition. Gold is June to August, the meteorological reading and the one a German household means, and the datapoint exists to measure whether a model picks a period at all rather than answering about the year.

labels.question: Wie viel habe ich last month fuer Groceries ausgegeben, also im November?
I am trying to work out where the money went last year, so could you tell me what I spent in each of the last three months of 2025, just the spending, not the salary?
Show me my total spending per month in 2025 as a line chart.
Wie haben sich meine Ausgaben pro Monat 2025 entwickelt? Zeig es als Liniendiagramm.
Chart my cumulative spending over 2025 as an area chart.
Zeig die kumulierten Ausgaben 2025 als Flaechendiagramm.
Show my spending per category in 2025 as a bar chart.
Ausgaben pro Kategorie 2025 als Balkendiagramm.
Which merchants took the most money in 2025? Show the top ten as a horizontal bar chart.
labels.note: Grouped by the enriched title, so the four friends behind PayPal are four small merchants and Allianz is tenth. That is the chart prompt's own rule; the SQL set groups the same question by counterparty, which is what its prompt asks for, and the two golds differ on purpose.

labels.question: Zeig die zehn groessten Haendler 2025 als liegendes Balkendiagramm.
Compare what I spent on groceries and on dining per quarter in 2025 as grouped bars.
Vergleiche Lebensmittel und Essengehen pro Quartal 2025 als gruppierte Balken.
labels.note: The request said 'Lebensmittel und Restaurants' while the gold is the whole Dining category. Now 'Lebensmittel und Essengehen', the same words as s26 and s32, and the eight figures are unchanged.

labels.question: Show my monthly spending split by category in 2025 as a stacked bar chart.
labels.note: Gold is the five largest categories by month, not because the statement should fold but because the app folds: eleven groups over a palette of six become the five largest plus one rest group, so these 60 figures come back either way.

labels.question: Monatliche Ausgaben nach Kategorie 2025 als gestapelte Balken.
Show the share of my 2025 spending by category as a doughnut.
labels.note: The five largest of eleven, for the same reason: a doughnut holds six slices and the app keeps five plus a rest.

labels.question: Zeig den Anteil der groessten Haendler an meinen Ausgaben 2025 als Donut.
Draw a sankey of my 2025 income flowing into the spending categories.
labels.note: One source into eleven targets, and the flows add up to the spending rather than to the income, which is what the chart prompt asks for: a link needs both ends and a total row would be a flow into itself.

labels.question: Zeig als Sankey, wie mein Einkommen 2025 in die Ausgabenkategorien fliesst.
Compare my total spending in the first half of 2025 with the second half in a chart.
Vergleiche meine Ausgaben im Januar 2025 mit denen im Juli 2025 als Diagramm.
Chart my spending per quarter in 2025.
Show my spending per day in March 2025 as a line chart.
Show what I spent on groceries per month in 2025.
Zeig die Ausgaben aller Kategorien 2025 als Balkendiagramm, auch die kleinen.
Chart my income and my spending per month in 2025 side by side.
Zeig den monatlichen Saldo 2025, also Einnahmen minus Ausgaben, als Diagramm.
Zeig als Donut, wie sich meine Lebensmittelausgaben 2025 auf die einzelnen Maerkte verteilen.
Draw a sankey of how my 2025 spending flows from its categories into their subcategories.
Zeig mir als Diagramm, wie viel von meinen Ausgaben 2025 kategorisiert ist und wie viel noch in Needs review liegt.
Wie verteilen sich meine PayPal-Zahlungen an Freunde 2025? Zeig es als Donut.
labels.note: Four people behind one counterparty, so only the enriched title splits them. A doughnut grouped by the counterparty is one slice of 619,50 EUR and answers nothing.

Show my grocery spending per quarter in 2025, split into supermarket, bakery and drugstore, as a stacked bar chart.

Which five merchants took the most money in the second half of 2025? Show them as horizontal bars.
